note: Lagoon Logs registers a Drupal logger service (logger.lagoon_logs, tagged 'logger') that ships watchdog messages over UDP to a Logstash endpoint as Logstash JSON via Monolog SocketHandler. All state lives in the lagoon_logs.settings config object: host (default application-logs.lagoon.svc), port (default 5140), identifier (default drupal), disable (default 0). The settings form only toggles disable and shows host/port/identifier read-only; host/port/identifier are changed via config. Medium/hard cases read/write lagoon_logs.settings, verified via drush. Reset/cleanup restore the shipped defaults explicitly (State is unreliable on this site).

evals.prompt: By default, where does the lagoon_logs Drupal module send its logs (host and port), and by what transport?
evals.expected_output: By default it sends logs over UDP to application-logs.lagoon.svc on port 5140 (config defaults host=application-logs.lagoon.svc, port=5140), using a Monolog SocketHandler with a Logstash JSON formatter.

evals.prompt: How do you stop the lagoon_logs module from shipping any logs? Name the configuration key and what happens when it is set.
evals.expected_output: Set the 'disable' key in lagoon_logs.settings to 1 (or tick 'Disable module' on /admin/config/development/lagoon_logs). When disable is truthy the factory returns FALSE for the identifier and LagoonLogsLogger::log() returns immediately, sending nothing.

evals.prompt: How does the lagoon_logs module capture Drupal's log messages — what service tag and library does it use?
evals.expected_output: It defines the service logger.lagoon_logs tagged with 'logger', so Drupal's LoggerChannelFactory routes every watchdog message to it. It builds a Monolog Logger with a SocketHandler (udp://host:port) and a LagoonLogsFormatter (LogstashFormatter) to emit Logstash JSON.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the lagoon_logs module has been pointed at a non-default log collector. Inspect the live configuration and report the Logstash host and port it currently sends logs to.
evals.expected_output: host=logs.probe.internal, port=6514 in lagoon_logs.settings. Read with `drush cget lagoon_logs.settings`.

evals.prompt: Inspect this site's lagoon_logs configuration and state the current Logstash leading identifier (application name) it tags logs with.
evals.expected_output: identifier=probe-app-x in lagoon_logs.settings. Discoverable via `drush cget lagoon_logs.settings identifier`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the lagoon_logs module to send logs to a custom Logstash collector at host collector.example.net on UDP port 5544. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: lagoon_logs.settings host == 'collector.example.net' and port == 5544 (e.g. drush cset lagoon_logs.settings host collector.example.net; drush cset lagoon_logs.settings port 5544).

evals.prompt: Our log collector is down and lagoon_logs is generating noise. Turn off log shipping for the lagoon_logs module on this site, and apply it live.
evals.expected_output: lagoon_logs.settings disable is truthy (1). Set via `drush cset lagoon_logs.settings disable 1` or the Disable checkbox on /admin/config/development/lagoon_logs.
